title: Apple unveils its first foldable, the iPhone Duo | TechCrunch
summary: On the battery front, the company said that with the inner display, users can get 31 hours of video playback, and with the outer display, 44 hours of video playback. Apple noted that later this year, the device will support Apple Pencil.
